modalities.evidence: 30 sessions of fMRI data from a single subject

output.population: Healthy left-handed male, aged 56 years, scanned 30 times over approximately 10 months
output.summary: Densely sampled single-subject dataset: 30 scanning sessions combining resting-state runs and six cognitive tasks (n-back, gradCPT, stop-signal, card guessing, Reading the Mind in the Eyes, movie watching), plus structural imaging.
